from app.api.handlers import handle_get_user_by_email

def test_handle_get_user_by_email():
    # Success
    status, user = handle_get_user_by_email({"email": "ada@example.com"})
    assert status == 200
    assert user["name"] == "Ada"

    # Not found
    status, result = handle_get_user_by_email({"email": "unknown@example.com"})
    assert status == 404
    assert result == {"error": "not found"}

    # Invalid email (missing)
    status, result = handle_get_user_by_email({})
    assert status == 400
    assert result == {"error": "invalid email"}

    # Invalid email (not a string)
    status, result = handle_get_user_by_email({"email": 123})
    assert status == 400
    assert result == {"error": "invalid email"}

    # Invalid email (no @)
    status, result = handle_get_user_by_email({"email": "invalidemail"})
    assert status == 400
    assert result == {"error": "invalid email"}

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_handle_get_user_by_email()
    print("Tests passed!")
"}
